questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to partner with Dr. Manal. According to Article 59, what element must absolutely be included in their partnership contract?
options: The professional independence of each practitioner
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The professional independence of each practitioner is the cornerstone of any partnership. Article 59 is very clear on this point.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will ensure the contract respects this principle.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal has drafted a partnership contract draft. According to Article 59, to which body must she submit it?
options: To the Regional Council of the Order
To the National Council of the Order
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The National Council of the Order verifies the conformity of partnership contracts with the Code of Ethics.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will prepare the file.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to replace a colleague on leave. According to Article 63, who must sign the health insurance forms?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal clarifies: 'The replacement dentist must personally sign the health insurance forms of the patients they treat.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will ensure I sign all my acts.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal is consulted by a patient already being followed by a colleague. According to Article 53, what is her first obligation?
options: Propose a joint consultation with the first practitioner
Take over the patient without notifying the colleague
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Proposing a joint consultation is a sign of respect toward the colleague. It's a rule of professional courtesy.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will apply this principle.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad was called urgently to replace an absent colleague. According to Article 53, what are his obligations?
options: Provide necessary care and inform the colleague upon their return
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'In case of emergency, you can provide necessary care. But you must inform the colleague upon their return.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will follow this protocol.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal is consulted as a dental expert. According to Article 47, can she reveal confidential information in her report?
options: No, she must only reveal elements necessary for the expertise
Yes, if she obtains the patient's consent
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Professional secrecy applies even to expertise. You must only reveal elements necessary for the mission.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will remember this rule.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, as a consultant, has given an opinion to a patient. According to Article 56, can he continue care?
options: No, except at the express request of the patient
Yes, if the treating colleague is behind schedule
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The consultant must not continue care, except at the express request of the patient. This is a rule of respect toward the treating colleague.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will respect this rule.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal disagrees with the treatment of a consulting colleague. According to Article 57, what should she do?
options: Decline all responsibility and refuse to apply the recommended treatment
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'In case of irreconcilable disagreement, the treating dentist may decline all responsibility and refuse to apply the recommended treatment.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will remember this rule.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has been elected to the municipal council. According to Article 22, can he use this position to attract patients?
options: Yes, if he mentions his position on his plaques
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Article 22 is very clear: the dentist who holds an elective office must not use it to increase their clientele.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will be careful not to mix the two.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal observes a violation of the code by a colleague. According to Article 64, within what deadline can she request a reform?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The request for reform must be presented within two months of notification of the decision.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will note this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has just registered with the Order registry. According to Article 65, what commitment must he make?
options: A commitment by oath to respect the code
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Upon your registration, you must acknowledge having read the code and commit, under oath, to respect it.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will take this commitment seriously.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal has changed her professional situation. According to Article 65, must she inform the National Council?
options: Yes, she must inform the Council of any change
Yes, but only in case of a change of practice
No, only the initial establishment is concerned
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Any change in your professional situation must be reported to the National Council.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will inform the Council of any change.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to make a communication about his practice. According to Article 14, who must approve this communication?
options: The Superior Council of the Order
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Announcements concerning the practice must be submitted for approval to the Superior Council of the Order.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will submit my project.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal is approached by an insurance company for an agreement. According to Article 38, what is her first step?
options: Submit the draft to the National Council for opinion
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Any draft agreement must be submitted for opinion to the National Council of the Order.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will follow this procedure.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, as an expert dentist, receives questions foreign to medical technique. According to Article 47, what must he do?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'You must recuse yourself if the questions are foreign to medical technique.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will follow this rule.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal, as an expert dentist, must write a report. According to Article 47, what must she reveal?
options: Only the elements necessary for the expertise
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'You must only reveal elements necessary for the expertise. The rest is confidential.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will respect this rule.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad is asked to replace a colleague. According to Article 63, must a student replacement have a stamp?
options: No, they cannot be required to have a stamp
Yes, if they are in their final year
No, if they are a replacement in the private sector
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The student replacement cannot be required to have a stamp, but they must mention 'the replacement' on their documents.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will inform myself about this practice.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal observes an important disagreement between her treatment and that of a consultant. According to Article 57, what is the possible outcome?
options: The treating dentist may decline all responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'In case of irreconcilable disagreement, the treating dentist is entitled to decline all responsibility.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will keep this option in mind.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has replaced a colleague and must sign insurance forms. According to Article 63, how should he sign?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The replacement dentist must personally sign the health insurance forms.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will sign in my own name.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal wishes to partner with a colleague. According to Article 59, the partnership contract must respect a fundamental principle. Which one?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Professional independence of each practitioner is the fundamental principle of partnerships.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will ensure the contract respects this principle.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has been approached by an insurance company for an agreement. According to Article 38, what is the role of the National Council?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'The National Council verifies the conformity of agreements with the Code of Ethics.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will submit the agreement to the Council.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal is asked for an expertise. According to Article 46, what is her obligation before starting?
options: Inform the person of her mission
Sign a contract with the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'You must inform the person you are examining of your expertise mission.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will follow this rule.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, as a consulting dentist, has given an opinion. According to Article 56, can he continue care if the patient asks?
options: Yes, at the express request of the patient
Yes, if the colleague is absent
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'You can continue care if the patient expressly requests it.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will respect the patient's will.'

questions.question: Dr. Manal disagrees with the consultant. According to Article 57, what is her right?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'In case of irreconcilable disagreement, you can decline all responsibility.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will remember this possibility.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, after assimilating the rules of partnership, receives congratulations from Dr. Manal. What is the next step?
questions.explanation: Dr. Manal explains: 'Mastering partnerships is a step. Expertise and control are the next steps.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will train in expertise.'
